title: Concrete Root-Uptake Crop-State Provider Readiness Evidence

day_start: croprotation(2) resolves crop calendar and emergence
newly active crop initializes root extension and root distribution
each_soil_water_step: Meteo(3) computes current timestep ET quantities including ptra
RootExtraction(2) consumes current ptra plus current noddrz/cumdens_top
day_end: update_rootextension updates rooting depth and noddrz
update_rootdistribution updates cumdens_top for subsequent root extraction
legacy_evaluation_point.important_physics_constraint: current-day root extension/distribution update occurs after current-day root extraction; moving it earlier changes B1.10 physics

rooted_nodes.preferred_target_semantics: derive from physically owned root geometry plus immutable grid where practical

cumulative_root_fraction.legacy_refresh: cropdevelopment day-end after root distribution update
cumulative_root_fraction.preferred_target_semantics: read-only derived view over current root-distribution state; persist only irreducible physical distribution state

potential_transpiration.legacy_refresh: every soil-water timestep immediately before root extraction
potential_transpiration.preferred_target_semantics: explicit current-interval ET result supplied to root uptake

why_a_single_hidden_provider_is_rejected: it would mix committed crop/root state with a dynamic ET process result
it would tend to capture MOD_meteo, MOD_cropdevelopment or plant_interface globals rather than explicit data
it would reintroduce hidden temporal ordering into an apparently timeless provider API
it would obscure the fact that ptra may vary within the day while root geometry/distribution follows the qualified legacy daily update order
it would make later alternative crop or ET implementations harder to compose cleanly

smallest_next_seam.owner: F-WOF / Crop, ET and root-uptake physics
smallest_next_seam.recommended_shape: explicit crop-root state snapshot/view plus explicit current potential-transpiration input assembled into crop_root_uptake_input_t
crop_root_snapshot_minimum: root geometry sufficient to determine rooted_nodes
current root-distribution physical state or current cumulative root-fraction view

tests.reason: readiness decision is source-ownership and call-order characterization; production implementation is explicitly forbidden until the missing crop/ET ownership seam exists
